Enemies that are drawn to {c_important}Exposed Roots{/c} have +{c_number}1{/c} {c_important}{b}{u}Monster Power{/c}{/b}{/u}.

Planting {c_important}Corrupted Roots{/c} in Helltides yields double rewards.

{icon:Marker_Season_Green_font,2.5}At Rank {c_number}22{/c} with the {c_important}Splinter of Terror{/c}, {c_important}{b}{u}Monster Power{/c}{/b}{/u} is increased by +{c_number}1{/c} more. Planting {c_important}Corrupted Roots{/c} in Helltides yields a large amount of {c_important}{u}Aberrant Cinders{/u}{/c}.
